globalFooter.title: MindWell Support – Open Source Mental Health Platform
globalFooter.desc1: MindWell is an open-source mental health platform dedicated to ethical support, awareness, and self-reflection for global and low-resource communities.
globalFooter.desc2: Aligned with UN Sustainable Development Goals 3 (Good Health) & 4 (Quality Education).
globalFooter.desc3: Free initial consultations are provided by our verified clinical psychologists subject to availability.
globalFooter.desc4: Important: MindWell is not a diagnostic or emergency medical service. If you are in crisis, please use our 24/7 Emergency Resources.

homePage.heroTitle: MindWell – Open Source Mental Health Platform

homePage.fundDesc: MindWell relies on ethical partnerships, grants, and community support. Contact us to discuss funding, collaboration, or research opportunities.
